title: Board Docket Terms: Switching Dockets and Advancement on the Docket (Decision Reviews and Appeals)
content:
## Board docket terms — Decision Reviews and Appeals

This schedule sets out, for each lane of Decision Reviews and Appeals, whether an appeal may be moved to another Board docket and on what terms, and the age and other grounds on which an appeal is advanced on the Board docket.

| Lane | Docket switch allowed | Switch period: calendar days after the Board receives the notice of disagreement (or one year from the decision notice, if later) | Switch barred once evidence or testimony has been submitted on the current docket | Age at or above which an appeal is advanced on the docket (years) | Other grounds for advancement on the docket |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supplemental Claim | No | 0 | No | 75 | Serious illness; severe financial hardship; other sufficient cause |
| Higher-Level Review | No | 0 | No | 75 | Serious illness; severe financial hardship; other sufficient cause |
| Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference | No | 0 | No | 75 | Serious illness; severe financial hardship; other sufficient cause |
| Board Appeal - Direct Review Docket | Yes | 60 | Yes | 75 | Serious illness; severe financial hardship; other sufficient cause |
| Board Appeal - Evidence Submission Docket | Yes | 60 | Yes | 75 | Serious illness; severe financial hardship; other sufficient cause |
| Board Appeal - Hearing Docket | Yes | 60 | Yes | 75 | Serious illness; severe financial hardship; other sufficient cause |

### Explanatory notes

- **Docket switch.** Only the three Board dockets allow an appeal to be moved to another Board docket. On each of them the switch period is 60 calendar days after the Board receives the notice of disagreement, or one year from the decision notice if that is later, and a switch is barred once evidence or testimony has been submitted on the current docket. The Supplemental Claim and both Higher-Level Review lanes show no switch and a period of 0 days.
- **Advancement on the docket.** The age figure is 75 years in every lane; an appellant aged 75 or older meets it, and an appellant aged 74 does not meet the age figure. The other grounds are serious illness, severe financial hardship and other sufficient cause.

### Hypothetical readings

| Hypothetical appellant | Age figure of 75 met | Ground listed in the schedule |
|---|---|---|
| Aged 75, no other ground shown | Yes | — |
| Aged 74, shows severe financial hardship | No | Yes, severe financial hardship |
| Aged 68, shows serious illness | No | Yes, serious illness |
| Aged 74, shows no listed ground | No | No |
